description: This file contains utility functions for generating and managing JSON form schemas, including functions for creating form objects, handling schema types, and merging form definitions. It is part of the legacy JSON form utilities in the Thingsboard project.

methods.name: stripNullType
methods.description: Removes 'null' from a schema type array if present, returning the non-null type.

methods.name: enumToTitleMap
methods.description: Converts an array of enum strings into an array of objects with name and value properties.

methods.name: canonicalTitleMap
methods.description: Converts a title map into a canonical form, optionally using an original enum for mapping.

methods.name: stdFormObj
methods.description: Creates a standard form object based on schema and options, setting properties like title, description, required, and validation messages.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Generates a text input form element if schema type is string and not an enum.

methods.name: numberType
methods.description: Generates a number input form element if schema type is number.

methods.name: integer
methods.description: Generates a number input form element for integer schema types.

methods.name: date
methods.description: Generates a date input form element if schema type is date.

methods.name: checkbox
methods.description: Generates a checkbox form element if schema type is boolean.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Generates a select dropdown form element if schema type is string with enum.

methods.name: checkboxes
methods.description: Generates a checkboxes form element if schema type is array with enum items.

methods.name: fieldset
methods.description: Generates a fieldset form element for object schemas, recursively processing properties.

methods.name: array
methods.description: Generates an array form element for array schemas, processing items.

methods.name: defaultFormDefinition
methods.description: Determines the default form element for a given schema based on type rules.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Generates default form definitions and lookup map for a schema object.

methods.name: postProcessFn
methods.description: Post-processing function for form array, currently returns input unchanged.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges form definitions with schema defaults, handling read-only states and nested items.
